name: 32655-multilora-gptoss120b-2gpu
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b. Sparse MoE, MXFP4 expert weights, ~65 GB of weights over 15 shards (122 GB on disk including the copy under `original/`, which is not loaded); cached locally.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, two GPUs of one node (--gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, expert parallelism off. Two cards is the smallest topology that holds the weights plus eight resident rank-8 adapter slots and still leaves a KV cache.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20% by completion, cooldown 10% (inert at this bound), bounded at 200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, streaming, no chat template: exactly 1600 prompt tokens and exactly 600 output tokens per request, `ignore_eos`, temperature 0.0, prompts on the wire as raw text. Every request carries one of the eight adapter names in scenario.json, drawn uniformly, so all eight slots stay live.
purpose: A specialized writing assistant serving eight customer-tuned variants of a large model, eight concurrent long-prompt streaming requests on two GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. The interpreter and the hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml.

model: openai/gpt-oss-120b

enable-lora: true
# Eight adapter slots resident at once. `max-lora-rank` must be at least the rank of the
# adapter the client attaches, or the engine refuses the LoRA request at load.
max-loras: 8
max-lora-rank: 8

tensor-parallel-size: 2

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
